title: Use timestamped link receipts in RplStack ingress
description: rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/receive.rs accepts now_ms but calls LinkLayer::receive_frame for both normal and border ingress (including bootstrap retry), producing logical ReceiptEvidence with monotonic_millis=None. Authenticated SCHC fragmentation requires monotonic_millis and therefore cannot consume frames admitted through the production RPL receive path; the supplied reception time is also discarded. Call receive_frame_at with the normalized now_ms on every attempt and add ingress tests proving duration-capable evidence and nondecreasing behavior.
